evals.prompt: I need to create a Hebrew Word document for a university assignment summary. It should have: a title 'סיכום עבודה סמינריונית', an intro paragraph in Hebrew (2-3 sentences), a section heading 'ממצאים עיקריים', 3 Hebrew bullet points, and a closing paragraph. Please write and run a Python script to generate this as assignment_summary.docx. Make sure it will render correctly in Microsoft Word (not just LibreOffice).
evals.expected_output: A working Python script that generates assignment_summary.docx using the Python+zipfile approach. The .docx file should pass RTL validation (full bidi/rtl coverage, Normal style defined). No npm/docx library.

evals.prompt: Create a professional Hebrew Word document for an energy technology comparison report. It should have a main title in Hebrew, an introductory paragraph explaining the purpose, and a 3-column comparison table with Hebrew headers (טכנולוגיה, עלות ממוצעת, יעילות) and at least 3 data rows. Save as energy_report.docx and run the script.
evals.expected_output: A working Python script that generates energy_report.docx with a proper RTL table. The table should use <w:bidiVisual/> so columns flow right-to-left. Passes validation.

evals.prompt: My Hebrew Word document looks perfect in LibreOffice — text is right-aligned, bullets are on the right. But when I open it in Microsoft Word, all the text is left-aligned and the bullet points appear on the left side. What are the root causes of this? Please provide a complete Python script that I can run on any Hebrew .docx to fix these RTL issues, without needing to unpack the file manually.
evals.expected_output: Clear explanation of the root causes (missing bidi at paragraph level, missing rtl at run level, Normal style not defined). A complete Python fix script that takes input/output paths and fixes document.xml, styles.xml, and numbering.xml. Runs as a standalone script.
